prompt: How do I change a flat tire on my car?
response: Changing a flat tire is a useful skill to have. First, find a safe place to pull over. Use your emergency lights to alert other drivers. Then, engage the parking brake and jack up the car using the spare jack. Remove the hubcap and place it on the ground. Use the lug wrench to loosen the lug nuts, then remove them. Carefully lift the flat tire and replace it with the spare. Tighten the lug nuts and lower the car.
